ProductQuery interface already declares optional 'featured?: boolean' field
Strict TypeScript: noUnusedLocals, noUnusedParameters, erasableSyntaxOnly — no dead code allowed

productService.ts has TODO markers at lines 23 and 34 for featured filter and rating_desc sort
features: Currently supported query params: search, category, inStock, sort (price_asc/price_desc/name_asc/name_desc), page, limit
inStock boolean parsing already implemented as the pattern to follow for featured
15 total products across 5 categories; none currently have the featured field set
Products requiring featured: true — id 1 (Laptop, electronics), id 8 (Ergonomic Chair, furniture), id 11 (Yoga Mat, sports), id 14 (Clean Code, books)
Remaining 11 products will have featured undefined (treated as false via ?? false)
Existing filters: search (substring match), category (case-insensitive equality), inStock (boolean match)

Test file covers: GET /products (6 tests), Auth middleware (4 tests), Pagination (3 tests), Featured filter (3 tests), Rating sort (1 test)
architecture: Flow: GET /products route → productController.ts → parseProductQuery() + getAllProducts(query) → JSON response
queryParser.ts: parseProductQuery() transforms raw req.query into typed ProductQuery; called in controller, not as middleware
productService.ts: single exported function getAllProducts(query: ProductQuery): Promise<PaginatedResponse<Product>>
Filter execution order: spread all products → search filter → category filter → inStock filter → [featured filter goes here] → sort → paginate
Sort logic uses [...result].sort(...) spread copy pattern consistently — rating_desc must follow same pattern
New featured filter belongs after inStock block in productService.ts (after line ~21)
New rating_desc sort belongs as additional else-if branch in the existing sort chain in productService.ts (after line ~33)
featured param parsing belongs after inStock parsing block in queryParser.ts (after line ~27)
rating_desc belongs added to VALID_SORT_OPTIONS array in queryParser.ts (line 3)
edgeCases: featured=undefined (param absent): must NOT filter — use 'if (query.featured !== undefined)' guard, consistent with inStock pattern
featured=maybe or any non-true/false value: queryParser leaves query.featured undefined, so no filter applied
Products without featured field: (p.featured ?? false) handles them — evaluates to false, so they appear in featured=false results and are excluded from featured=true results
featured filter is conjunctive (AND) with all other filters — featured=true&category=electronics returns only id 1
rating_desc sort must use spread copy [...result].sort(...) not result.sort(...) to avoid mutating the filtered array
rating_desc combined with featured filter: filter runs before sort, so sort operates on already-filtered subset — no special handling needed
Exactly 4 products must have featured: true (ids 1, 8, 11, 14); all others must NOT have featured: true (field absent or false)
featured=false must return exactly 11 products (15 total minus 4 featured)
